## Final report

Problem: scheduled mirror run 33426859481 failed the reconciler cwd-independence test under clean wheel install.

Verdict: product behavior correct; test wrong. c0b9-33b0-f968-450d / commit 71eef3f56dc5 define Option C: REBAR_ROOT -> validated package root -> validated cwd toplevel -> clear error. The no-checkout wheel case must raise; adjacent test already pins that.

Fix: test-only change in tests/scripts/test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py. The cwd-independence oracle now creates a valid owned editable/source checkout via rebar.config.__file__ before switching to an unrelated checkout.

Evidence [non-codebase]: RED reproduced locally with built wheel, outside cwd, REBAR_ROOT unset. GREEN after fix: targeted resolver selection 3 passed; full file 14 passed; make lint passed; clean wheel/outside-cwd replication 3 passed. Mutation under macOS sandbox-exec: reverting the precondition returned the test to RED with the same RuntimeError.

Gerrit [non-codebase]: change 2465 merged as b96708548732321842d76851824aefa7603fc3ca; LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; CI run 33450304129 success.

Attribution: caused by c0b9-33b0-f968-450d as a plan/test escape. Early caused_by link was refused because that target has no attached commit in the ticket graph; no force used. Close will pass --caused-by=c0b9-33b0-f968-450d. Class: plan_defect.

Safety/siblings: product code unchanged, no new dependency, no test weakening; no siblings. Residual risk: none observed.
